_comment: PAF model pricing table — maintained by the factory, used by the cost-reporting helper. USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Every rate is listed per model exactly as the pricing page states it: cache rates are not a fixed multiple of input across models (cache read is 0.1x input on most models but 0.05x on Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5). A model priced by prompt length carries 'prompt_tiers' instead of flat rates: an ordered list where each request is priced at the first tier whose 'max_prompt_tokens' is at least that request's prompt length (input + cache reads + cache writes); the last tier has no cap. Model keys MUST be dateless ('claude-haiku-4-5', never 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001'): the helper strips a trailing -YYYYMMDD snapshot date before lookup, because pricing is per model and not per snapshot, so a dated key could never match.
_source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (model pricing, prompt caching and long context pricing sections), read 2026-10-09
_usd_to_eur_source: ECB euro reference rates (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates) — maintained; update alongside the model rates. Captured 2026-06-08.

claude-haiku-5-5._note: Priced per request by prompt length (input + cache reads + cache writes): up to 100,000 tokens the first tier, over 100,000 the second.

claude-opus-5._note: Fast mode (speed: fast) is billed at $10.00 input / $50.00 output per MTok; the ledger does not distinguish speeds, so a fast-mode run is under-priced here.
